newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 14-day fixed tender at 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 14-day fixed tender at 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it was setting a tender for 14-day securities repurchase funds at a fixed rate of 3.00 percent.
Funds will be credited to accounts on Wednesday and the securities have to be repurchased on July 16, the German central bank said in a statement.
An 81.0 billion mark facility set at a fixed rate of 3.00 percent expires on Wednesday.
The repo rate, the Bundesbank's main money market rate, has remained fixed at 3.00 percent since August 1996.
